scope: Recurrent instrument hypotheses from paid readings. All arms start empty; no supplied source program, private parameter, required measurement, diagnostic choice or action score. Finite-history and direct-control response explanations compete normally. Development and main cohorts are evaluated separately, after all declared learning in each cohort. First two main apparatus have one recurrent state; last two and development have two distinct recurrent states. State count is private to the generator. Development uses the released working source; main runtime is frozen after development.
persistence: Restore complete UnifiedResearchSession JSON between stages.
cost_accounting: Source learning and all unsuccessful research included; terminal resources separate.
